statements.attributed: synthesized high-entropy transition metal borides with higher hardness and oxidation resistance than individual metal diborides
statements.quote: Several high-entropy transition metal borides were synthesized recently , and their hardness and oxidation resistance were shown to be higher/better than the average performances of five individual metal diborides made by identical fabrication processing.

statements.attributed: combined materials synthesis and structural/compressibility measurements in a single experiment
statements.quote: Our motivation in this paper is to examine the structural and mechanical properties of high-entropy borides (HEBs) under combined high-pressure and high-temperature conditions, where materials synthesis and structural/compressibility measurements are combined in a single experiment .

statements.attributed: high-pressure high-temperature synthesized sample was not recovered at ambient conditions
statements.quote: In our earlier study on the synthesis of (Hf, Mo, Zr, Ta, Ti)B2 material (reported in ), the high-pressure high-temperature synthesized sample was not recovered at ambient conditions and, hence, only limited information on morphological, structural, element mapping, and mechanical properties could be gathered.

statements.attributed: best thermal oxidation resistance of all known transition metal borides up to 1200 °C
statements.quote: The (Hf, Mo, Nb, Ta, Ti)B2 material was chosen for detailed high-pressure, high-temperature investigation because it is known to have the best thermal oxidation resistance of all the known transition metal borides up to 1200 °C , and our preliminary mechanical property measurements indicate that (Hf, Mo, Nb, Ta, Zr)B2 has a high hardness value amongst HEB materials.
